# Ahmad Muhanna — AI Trainer in Dubai, UAE (أحمد مهنا — مدرب ذكاء اصطناعي في دبي)

> Ahmad Muhanna is an AI trainer based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. He teaches practical AI, prompt engineering and AI automation in Arabic and English to individuals, business owners, companies and kids, on-site across the UAE and GCC or online. He is a trainer at NCI – Nations Coaching Institute (Dubai), co-founder of the Dubai digital agency Cyber Pixel (since 2013), founder of WATSIN.NET (an AI-agents platform) and Project Manager at Dune AI, with 20+ years in technology. أحمد مهنا مدرب ذكاء اصطناعي في دبي يقدم دورات وورش عمل عملية في الذكاء الاصطناعي وهندسة الأوامر باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية للأفراد وأصحاب الأعمال والشركات والأطفال.

## Training workshops (حقيبة الورش التدريبية)

- [AI Fundamentals — الأساسيات في الذكاء الاصطناعي](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): Use AI confidently in daily work; 2 hours, expandable to a full day.
- [Prompt Engineering Mastery — احتراف هندسة الأوامر](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): Write reliable prompts and build a reusable prompt library for your own tasks; half-day.
- [AI for Marketing & Content — الذكاء الاصطناعي للتسويق والمحتوى](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): Campaigns, copy, images and video with AI; 2 hours.
- [Automation & AI Agents — الأتمتة ووكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): No-code automations and working AI agents with n8n, Make and Zapier; half-day.
- [AI for Business Owners & Managers — الذكاء الاصطناعي لأصحاب الأعمال](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): AI strategy, ROI and adoption for leaders; 2 hours.
- [Kids AI Workshops — ورش الذكاء الاصطناعي للأطفال](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): Safe, hands-on AI for children aged 8–14; 2 hours per session.

Corporate workshops are quoted per team (no public price); request a proposal on WhatsApp +971 52 234 6020.

## One Million Prompters: short answer

One Million Prompters (مليون خبير لأوامر الذكاء الاصطناعي) is a Dubai initiative announced on 21 May 2024 by Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, to train one million people in AI prompt engineering over three years. It is run by the Dubai Future Foundation and the Dubai Centre for Artificial Intelligence. The official course is online at https://omp.dub.ai/ and has four modules (Unleashing the Power of AI; Commanding Conversations with AI Chatbots; AI-Powered Productivity Revolution; Creative Frontiers with Generative AI), about three hours in total, with Prompt Literacy Certification as its outcome. Ahmad Muhanna is not an official provider of the initiative; his page explains how to join and offers live practice workshops in Arabic and English afterwards.
